Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.gl

Class ProcessingGlCapabilities

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.gl.ProcessingGlCapabilities
public final class ProcessingGlCapabilities extends Object
Snapshot of the OpenGL capabilities exposed through Processing's active PGL context.

    • isHardwareRasterizerKnown

      public boolean isHardwareRasterizerKnown()
      Reports whether JOGL supplied explicit hardware-rasterizer evidence.

      This distinguishes an unavailable classification from an explicit software-rasterizer result.

      Returns:
      true when the hardware classification is known

    • isHardwareRasterizer

      public boolean isHardwareRasterizer()
      Reports whether JOGL classifies the active OpenGL profile as hardware-backed.

      This value is meaningful when isHardwareRasterizerKnown() returns true.

      Returns:
      true when JOGL reports a hardware rasterizer

    • supportsTexture

    • supportsGpuTimerQuery

      public boolean supportsGpuTimerQuery()
      Reports whether desktop OpenGL advertises the core/ARB GPU timer-query API. OpenGL ES disjoint timers are intentionally excluded because they require different validity handling. Runtime collection additionally requires non-zero timestamp counter bits from the active context.
      Returns:
      true for desktop OpenGL 3.3+ or ARB_timer_query
